properties.description: Anthony, 2026-09-13, minutes after accepting the design-reference requirement: "in a large design, I'm not sure [re-injecting the design] is a good idea. Say I was designing an exhaust manifold for an engine of a car and the manifold was taking a long time — I don't think it'd be appropriate to say, here is the whole car design again. It may be more appropriate that the neighbourhood of the design was re-injected. Or in terms of systems engineering, maybe its black box and interface were injected. That may help keep the AI agent focused and not flood context with a lot of non-relevant information." The requirement as first written said the reference is sized to hold the design; this revision makes the unit of the reference the black box under work — its function, its constraints, its ports, and the far side of each port — and never the design as a whole.
properties.name: The agent's design reference is scoped to the black box under work and its interfaces, not the whole design
